result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your scan on 22 September 2026 was a dating scan. It showed you are 10 weeks pregnant. The letter says you talked about your sertraline at the appointment. The letter tells you to keep taking it.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking your sertraline 50 milligrams once a day.
2. Go to your booking appointment with the midwife on Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00.

## Dates and medicines
- 22 September 2026: your dating scan.
- Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00: booking appointment with the midwife.
- Sertraline: 50 milligrams, once a day. No change. Continue taking it.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Can I ask more about taking sertraline during my pregnancy?
- What will happen at my booking appointment?
- Who do I call if I cannot go to the appointment?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
